row.team_price_text: Light: flat per-site plan, 2 site collaborators (served page showed $17.77/mo incl. GST; prices vary by location)
row.evidence: Wix Help Center: "SCIM is available to all Enterprise customers on an opt-in basis. Reach out to your account manager to enable SCIM for your organization."
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated). SCIM and SSO (OIDC only) are Wix Studio for Enterprise features; Enterprise is custom-priced (plans 'tailored'); June's 'Enterprise starts ~$500/mo' has no first-party source and is dropped. Site plans (Light, Core, Business, Business Elite) are flat per site, so per-user prices are null (June's 17 per-user value is removed). The served plans page showed localised prices ($17.77 / $29.77 / $39.77 / $159.77 per month incl. GST) with the note that prices vary by location and are for yearly subscriptions; the JS-rendered US prices could not be loaded (renderer blocked on wix.com). SCIM is opt-in via the account manager; the help guide documents Microsoft Entra (custom non-gallery app with tenant URL + provisioning token) and says other IdPs need Wix Customer Care first. Groups map to Wix roles. Account-level team-management API exists but needs an account-level API key 'available to selected beta users only'.

auth.token_source: Enterprise dashboard > Security > SSO and SCIM Settings > SCIM > Verify & Generate Token (email 6-digit code); managed under Settings > API Keys
auth.notes: Token is pasted into Entra's Secret Token field; rotation revokes the old key immediately.

endpoints.notes: Endpoints are not enumerated; Users and Groups inferred from user and group sync described in the guide.

operations.notes: Updates sync role, details and group (c16); HTTP verbs not documented, so row update=true from the documented sync behaviour.

deprovision.notes: Guide says SCIM can automate 'deleting a team member's Wix account when you remove them in your IdP'; whether this removes the team membership or the whole Wix user account is not detailed.

roles.how: IdP groups mapped to Wix roles in SCIM settings; a default role applies to new synced groups; users with no group go to an 'Ungrouped' default group

limitations.text: Only Microsoft Entra (Azure) is documented; other IdPs require contacting Wix Customer Care first.
Users who already have a Wix account outside the organization's account are not synced and return an error.
SCIM is opt-in and must be enabled by the account manager.
Disabling SCIM does not remove previously synced team members; they are disconnected from their groups.
Requires a role with the Manage SSO and SCIM permission.

capabilities.notes: remove_member removes a team member from the account (not a delete of the Wix user).

endpoints.purpose: Create Invite: invite up to 50 team members with roles

webhooks_user_events.notes: A Contributor Created event page exists in the API menu but was not loaded.

limitations.text: Account-level team APIs need an account-level API key, currently available to selected beta users only.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/wix returns 404; Wix documents Okta only for OIDC SSO (custom OIDC app).

entra.notes: Custom non-gallery Enterprise application with Wix SCIM tenant URL and token; SSO via an Entra App Registration (OIDC).
